modern: An arrow moves in one way, the mind in another. The mind indeed, both when it is being cautious and when it is busy with inquiry, moves straight onward none the less, and towards its object.
original: In one way an arrow moves, in another way the mind. The mind indeed, both when it exercises caution and when it is employed about inquiry, moves straight onward not the less, and to its object.
notification: An arrow moves in one way, the mind in another.
notification_original: In one way an arrow moves, in another way the mind.
